_about: Root's Autumn map as printed (the digital edition uses the same board). Read clearing by clearing from the board art on the Root Database (https://www.therootdatabase.com/map/autumn/, image /media/boards/Map_-_Autumn.webp): suit icon and tree colour agree for all 12 clearings (fox = red, rabbit = yellow, mouse = orange, matching the ROOT logo letters); building slots are the white squares; the four ruins are the slots drawn with rubble; paths are the white dotted lines; the river is the blue line. Cross-checked against the official Learning to Play walkthrough (keep 'in the top-left fox clearing'; the Eyrie in the bottom-right corner move 'from the rabbit clearing west to the mouse clearing'; 'the central fox clearing'). Still to confirm on the creator's PC: Root's own clearing ids for each row.
letters: A..L are this file's own labels, by position on the board (top-left to bottom-right).
_river_note: The river runs from the top edge through B, past E, through G and K, and out west into the lake at I. Rivers are not paths except for the Riverfolk; the river links B-E, E-G, G-K and K-I.
